svg.text: Basis x = 4: 16 · 16 = 256 = 4⁴, an equality. Strict for every x ≥ 5; verified to x = 3000.

The curves cross at x ≈ −0.767, 2 and 4. The only integer
strictly between 2 and 4 is 3, the lone failure.
x² ≤ 2ˣ is x1/x ≤ 21/2. Since 21/2 = 41/4 ≈ 1.4142 and x1/x peaks at e, the integers 2 and 4 tie
and 3 alone exceeds them (31/3 ≈ 1.4422): the same exceptional 3 as in n³ < 3ⁿ.
THE LEMMA AND THE SILVER RATIO
(k+1)² ≤ 2k² iff k² − 2k − 1 ≥ 0 iff k ≥ 1 + √2 ≈ 2.414, the silver ratio; for integers, k ≥ 3.
It is strict there, so equality at x = 4 becomes strict inequality from x = 5 on.
